comment: File Explorer: folders in "This PC" and the navigation pane. 28.09.2026, customer file
enable_namespaces_in_mypc.reg; values checked on Windows 11 25H2 (26200), reference card 19. More entries and

rules.title: Show "Desktop" in "This PC"
rules.summary: The "Desktop" folder is visible in "This PC" above the drives, as in Windows 10.
rules.effect: Starting with version 22H2, Windows 11 hides user folders in "This PC"; the rule brings this entry back. Off by default: the folder stays hidden.
rules.versions: Windows 11 22H2 and later; in 24H2 and 25H2 all entries exist and are hidden by the value HiddenByDefault = 1. Written to both the 64-bit and the 32-bit (WOW6432Node) branches so that dialogs of 32-bit programs match File Explorer.
rules.rollback: Value 1 in both branches (the Windows 11 24H2 and 25H2 default).

rules.effect: Both entries lead to the same profile folder; Windows 10 showed only the first one. Do not turn it on together with the rule Show "Documents" in "This PC": the folder may appear twice.

rules.title: Show "3D Objects" in "This PC"
rules.summary: The "3D Objects" folder is visible in "This PC" again, as in Windows 10.
rules.effect: Windows 11 removed the entry, but the known folder is still registered. The rule creates the entry in both branches. Windows does not create the folder with a new profile; whether opening the entry creates it is to be checked in a virtual machine. Off by default.
rules.versions: Windows 10 1709 to 22H2 showed the folder on their own; Windows 11 has no entry. Check the effect on 25H2 on a test PC.
rules.rollback: Value 1 in both branches hides the entry again (the automatic return to defaults writes it). To remove the entry completely, delete the {0DB7E03F-FC29-4DC6-9020-FF41B59E513A} key in both NameSpace branches.

rules.title: Hide "Gallery" in the File Explorer navigation pane
rules.summary: The "Gallery" item (a view of all photos) is not shown in the left pane of File Explorer for any user.
rules.effect: Fewer unnecessary items in File Explorer; the photos themselves and the "Pictures" folder remain available.
rules.rollback: Delete the HiddenByDefault value in both branches.

rules.title: Hide "Home" in the File Explorer navigation pane
rules.summary: The "Home" item (recent files and pinned folders) is not shown in the left pane of File Explorer; File Explorer opens to "This PC".
rules.effect: Recent files are not visible when File Explorer opens. Off by default: combined with the folders hidden in "This PC", users lose a quick way to "Documents" and "Desktop"; turn it on together with the rules Show ... in "This PC".
rules.risk: According to user reports, the pinned Quick access folders disappear together with "Home".
rules.rollback: Delete the HiddenByDefault value in both branches.

rules.title: Open File Explorer to "This PC"
rules.summary: File Explorer (Win+E) opens to "This PC", not to "Home".
rules.effect: Drives and folders of "This PC" are visible right away. Needed by the rule Hide "Home", otherwise File Explorer has nowhere to open.
rules.rollback: File Explorer Options -> Open File Explorer to: "Home".
